estimand: the number of flagged contracts, within the examined Base frame, whose operational-codebook label disagrees with the rule; an upper 95% confidence bound on that count, not a false-positive rate against abuse
design: flagged contracts are a census per stratum (M_h known); labels are a stratified sample without replacement; the region is the inversion of the exact test on the total, intersected with the data-consistent box

ignorability.allocation_note: one allocation attaining k_max, the one with the largest tail; others may attain it too, so it need not match the library's
